detailed_descriptions.en: The Moon is covered in dust. The Lunar Surface Department (LSD) has sent you and your crew to clean it up. Unfortunately, the budget only covered a toothbrush. Collect lunar dust, sell and use the earnings to buy better tools and upgrade your equipment. Turn an underfunded cleanup mission into a growing operation, one painfully small brushstroke at a time. Team up in online co-op lobbies of up to 16 players. Spread out to cover more ground or tackle the same area together. There’s enough dust to keep everyone busy. Whether everyone actually works is another matter. Fill your storage with lunar dust, deliver it to a depot and launch shipments to get paid. Spend your earnings on new cleaning tools and increased carrying capacity so you can take on bigger jobs between deliveries. Watch dusty terrain turn clean with every pass. Track your progress across the lunar surface, place depots near your work and put cleaning vehicles to use as your operation grows. Stop being lazy, you’ve got whole Moon to clean. Better get started.
